cards.card_text: Then Bildad asks, "Does God pervert justice?
Elihu says it AGAIN, like a man who just found his caps lock key: God does not act wickedly, and the Almighty does not pervert justice.
cards.verse_text: Indeed, it is true that God does not act wickedly, and the Almighty does not pervert justice.
cards.snippet: …true that God does not act wickedly, and the Almighty does not pervert justice.

cards.card_text: Solomon says, "He who walks in integrity walks securely…" True or false: he says the one who perverts his ways will never be found out.
cards.verse_text: He who walks in integrity walks securely, but he who perverts his ways will be found out.
cards.snippet: He who walks in integrity walks securely, but he who perverts his ways will be found out.

cards.card_text: He says they despise justice and pervert all that is right.
cards.verse_text: Now hear this, O leaders of the house of Jacob and rulers of the house of Israel, who despise justice and pervert all that is right,
cards.snippet: …Jacob and rulers of the house of Israel, who despise justice and pervert all that is right,

cards.verse_text: For the wicked hem in the righteous, so that justice is perverted.
cards.snippet: For the wicked hem in the righteous, so that justice is perverted.
